title: Bootstrap-register tenant command
description: The only registration path without a TenantOnboardingRequest, for tenants that predate the admission workflow (migration and platform bootstrap, e.g. the first-party Nabhold group). It needs the privileged tenant:bootstrap scope, is disabled in the Control Plane unless explicitly enabled, and records its reason and evidence in the audit trail. It is never a shortcut around admission for a new customer.

bootstrap_reason.description: Why this tenant is registered outside the admission workflow.

evidence_reference.description: A reference to the evidence authorising the bootstrap (for example a migration record or board resolution). Evidence content is never stored in the Control Plane.
